metric_status: Noncanonical incremental debugging aggregate; do not add grouped people counts.
interpretation: Four retry events: three recovered and one exhausted. The exhausted tick was on Android 2.7.0, runtime 1e5c2708a94683a437bc4fecf3a601cd58479914. These events do not establish lost server writes or a demonstrated SDK58 cause.
limitations: Same consent, event-delivery and retry-ladder coverage limits as the 21 November baseline.
A lack of SDK58 retry events does not qualify the receiving release or provide a save-success denominator.
query: SELECT properties.$os AS os, properties.$app_version AS version, properties.$app_build AS build, properties.ota_runtime_version AS runtime, properties.ota_update_id AS ota, properties.ota_is_embedded AS embedded, properties.tableName AS table_name, properties.operation AS operation, properties.outcome AS outcome, properties.wasOffline AS offline, properties.jsRestartCount AS restarts, count() AS events, uniq(person_id) AS people FROM events WHERE timestamp >= '2026-11-21' AND timestamp < '2026-11-22' AND event = 'Offline Local Write Attempt Failed' AND {filters} GROUP BY os,version,build,runtime,ota,embedded,table_name,operation,outcome,offline,restarts ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 150
